adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is explicitly set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null`). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which is a no-op when `destinationCalendar` is `null`, so the collected team members’ destination calendars are silently discarded. This is directly verifiable from the diff; whether downstream fallback creates events anyway is not fully shown here, but the multi-host destination calendars gathered in `teamDestinationCalendars` will not be applied in exactly this configuration.
